references.text: Eliab, son of Helon, is mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Zebulun during the census, illustrating how leaders were appointed for each tribe.
Eliab, son of Helon, from the tribe of Zebulun, brought offerings at the dedication of the tabernacle, demonstrating the tribe's role and leadership.
Eliab, son of Helon, led the army of Zebulun during the wilderness journey, showing the tribe's military organization.
Zebulun was Jacob's tenth son, born to Leah. This is the foundation for the tribe of Zebulun mentioned here.
Jacob's blessing over Zebulun describes the tribe's future territory by the sea.
Describes Zebulun's inheritance allotment given when the land was distributed, which Elizaphan was to help with.
